items.description: When constructing proto-compatible objects manually (not via create()), set $typeName as const and $unknown: undefined. Example: { ..., $typeName: 'dnd5e.api.v1alpha1.EntityPlacement' as const, $unknown: undefined }. This is a protobuf-es v2 requirement.

In useEncounterStream, optionsRef.current = options on every render prevents stale closures inside long-lived async stream callbacks. Use this pattern in any hook that accepts callbacks and maintains async loops.
Connect stream, buffer events (isSyncingRef), fetch snapshot, replay buffer, set synced. This sequence in useEncounterStream is the canonical pattern for joining a real-time encounter mid-stream.

mergeRoom() in useDungeonMap is immutable — it never mutates input state. All geometry accumulation is via new Map/Set construction. Use this pattern for any state that needs to accumulate across events.
wallKey(wall) canonicalizes wall endpoints by sorting them lexicographically, so the same physical wall shared between two rooms produces one map entry regardless of direction.
